meaning:
1) to pull or tear away
1a) (Qal) to tear away, tear down
1b) (Niphal) to be torn away
Aramaic equivalent: ne.sach (נְסַח "to pull away" H5256)

elsewhere.note: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you.…
God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living.
But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
